issue.title: RefsInspectorScrollTests hosted-notes paging assertions fail on macOS CI since 2837025 and mask the Bundle/launch gates
issue.description:
Repo: bob-mac-capture (linked), master 6c4209b. GitHub Actions run 38464978866 (macOS 26 SwiftPM) executed 2066 tests with exactly 4 failures, all in `Tests/BobMacCaptureTests/RefsInspectorScrollTests.swift`:

- `testHostedNotesAtBottomRevealPages` — line 632: "inspector offset did not change as expected; lookup=found clip=(0.0, 0.0, 405.0, 462.0) docHeight=239.0 flipped=true insets=NSEdgeInsets(top: 0.0, left: 0.0, bottom: 0.0, right: 0.0)"; line 392: ("6") is not equal to ("8"); line 396: ("1") is not equal to ("2").
- `testHostedShortContentRevealsWithNoOffsetChange` — line 422: ("3") is not equal to ("6").

The same two tests fail identically on runs 38438769006 (2837025, the commit that introduced them: "feat(refs-inspector): page revealed notes with reveal-memory reset", plan:202610/refs_inspector_notes_paging.md, which has no bead), 38462257320 (b0e2ff2), and 38464978866 (6c4209b). The last green run is 38424226217 (4da688e), just before 2837025.

Impact: the Test step fails, so the Bundle, Verify plist and signature, Launch smoke test, and install gates are skipped for every later commit. Those gates have not run since 2837025, including for the bob-cli-7c Successor Offers in-panel choice work (all its pull-in suites passed in the same run).

Proposed by bob-cli-7c.7 (note #3) and bob-cli-7c.8 (note #1); filed by the bob-cli-7c land agent. Not caused by bob-cli-7c (the failures predate 395c521 and touch no successor code).

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic: the same two tests fail with the same assertion values on three consecutive CI runs (38438769006 at 2837025, 38462257320 at b0e2ff2, 38464978866 at 6c4209b); no run since 2837025 has passed them.

issue.creation_reason: Every bob-mac-capture CI run since 2837025 fails the Test step on the same two RefsInspectorScrollTests, so the Bundle, signature, launch, and install gates have not run for any later commit.

evidence.note: Independent corroboration from the approved 202610/mac_pull_in_build_fix plan: RefsInspectorScrollTests still fails deterministically from 2837025, with runs 38438769006 and 38464978866 reporting 6≠8, 1≠2, and 3≠6 plus the 239-point document-height offset failure. The plan confirms this predates and is independent of the pull-in changes.

Independent reproduction by the bob-cli-7k (Bob Refs ⌃Y Copy card) land agent: bob-mac-capture CI run 38601917702 at 2b7b330 (macOS 26 SwiftPM) executed 2128 tests with exactly the same 4 failures in RefsInspectorScrollTests (392: 6≠8, 396: 1≠2, 422: 3≠6, 652: offset did not settle around 2265.0, docHeight=239.0). Every bob-cli-7k commit run (38575168896, 38579638054, 38585800347, 38588971182) and the pre-epic baseline 44051a0 (run 38486137058) fail Test the same way, so Bundle/signature/launch/install gates still have not run for the Copy card work. Not caused by bob-cli-7k (the epic does not touch RefsInspectorScrollTests or the inspector scroll path).

payload.description: Verify the corroborated pre-existing scroll test failure before closing the parent epic

evidence.note: Independent reproduction by the bob-cli-7n land agent: bob-mac-capture CI run 38617607253 at f2a5cb5 (the bob-cli-7n.7 Blocks picker commit) fails the same RefsInspectorScrollTests (375: 3≠6, 392: 3≠8, 422: 3≠6, 453: 3≠8, 632: offset did not change, docHeight=239.0), plus testHostedTwoRapidRevealsStackTwoPages. Bundle, launch, and install gates were skipped again. f2a5cb5 touches no Refs source or tests.

Still failing at bob-mac-capture e959476 (bob-cli-7w.5): macOS CI run 38807458658 fails RefsInspectorScrollTests.testHostedShortContentRevealsWithNoOffsetChange (RefsInspectorScrollTests.swift:422 3 != 6; :427 29.0 != 0.0 ±2.0, clip=(0,29,388,462) docHeight=491). These are 2 of the 8 failures in that 2213-test run; the other new failure is the bob-cli-7w template test, which the epic's landing fixes.

Still failing on newer master: plan:202610/fix_mac_capture_install_build.md cites runs 38750465645, 38807458658, 38813536247 failing RefsInspectorScrollTests.testHostedShortContentRevealsWithNoOffsetChange — same test as this bead.
